name: Wire manipulator
group: Fraunhofer IPA, Project Group for Automation in Medicine and Biotechnology (T. Behr, L. Karstensen, J. Stallkamp) / KIT then FAU Erlangen-Nuernberg (F. Mathis-Ullrich)
versions: 2019 CDBME test bench (behr2019_deep: 'experimental robotic manipulator' for the two guidewire DOF, 300 mm linear travel, infinite rotation, PMMA phantom, Sec. 2.4); 2020 CDBME 2D phantom bench (karstensen2020_autonomous: 'testbench manipulator ... reused', Materials and methods, Fig. 1); 2022 IJCARS (ex-vivo liver); 2025 CBM stEVE benchmark (camera and fluoroscopy benches)
target_anatomy: hepatic veins (porcine liver ex vivo); aortic arch phantoms; planar PMMA / 3D-printed 2D vessel phantoms (2019, 2020)
devices_driven: one guidewire (0.035 in Terumo Radifocus angled stiff)
translation_detail: linear-stage+clamp (wire fixed to a stepper on a linear rail driven by a second stepper)
rotation_detail: stepper with the wire attached directly (infinite rotation)
imaging_compat: C-arm fluoroscopy with recurrent-CNN tip tracker; or overhead camera (2019-2020: camera above, light source below the phantom emulating fluoroscopy, 5 Hz; karstensen2020 Methods)
validation_detail: 2019: 10 sim-trained DDPG runs on a PMMA bifurcation phantom (behr2019 Sec. 3); 2020: 2D glycerin-water phantom, sim-trained DDPG+HER on the bench (karstensen2020 Results); 2022: 30 targets (10 per main vein) in one ex-vivo porcine liver; 2025: 100 + 100 camera trials, 10 fluoroscopy trials on printed arch phantoms
key_numbers: 2019: sim 89.6% (DDPG+HER) -> bench 7/10 (behr2019 Sec. 3); 2020: sim max 96% after 52,500 episodes, bench 'same results as in simulation', 100% with the next bifurcation as interim target (karstensen2020 Results); 2022: sim 100% (150/150) -> ex vivo 30% (9/30; wrong branch 10, entanglement 11); 2025: BasicWireNav sim 98% -> camera 97%, fluoroscopy 10/10; ArchVariety sim 90% -> camera 84%; action limits +-10 mm/s, +-6.28 rad/s at 7.5 Hz
sim_model: yes: SOFA + BeamAdapter (behr2019_deep, karstensen2020_autonomous, karstensen2022_learning), stEVE (karstensen2025_learning)
sim2real_detail: yes: behr2019_deep (full) DDPG sim 89.6% -> bench 7/10; karstensen2020_autonomous (full) DDPG+HER sim 96% -> bench same, 100% with interim targets; karstensen2022_learning (full) 100% sim -> 30% ex vivo; karstensen2025_learning (via the sim-to-real study table) 97%/84%/10-of-10
